analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($56.80) vs SMA5($56.99)/SMA20($56.28)/SMA50($54.11) — Above SMA20, below SMA5, indicating short-term resistance.
· High position relative to SMA100($52.29)/SMA200($52.49) — Maintaining medium-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (91.9%) — Sideways consolidation near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (63.7→60.7) — Staying in neutral zone, cooling off after overbought.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1021→-0.0527) — Improving but still negative, weak convergence continues.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $56.28) — Trading around the middle band, with a narrowing band width of 4.02%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($55.45) — Close to Pivot S1($55.30), based on previous lows.
· Swing Resistance ($56.94) — Close to current price, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) — 5-day high $57.60, 20-day high $57.60, 5-day low $56.18, 20-day low $54.95 — No clear pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.20x) — Significantly lower volume than the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation) — Lack of directional momentum due to neutral RSI, weak MACD convergence, and low volume. Awaiting breakout above 56.94 resistance or confirmation of 55.45 support.

analysis.patternNoteEn: After 5 consecutive days of gains, the price has fallen below the 5-day moving average, forming a sideways pattern confirming short-term resistance.

analysis.riskNote: ADX가 30.4로 뚜렷한 추세를 나타내지만, 거래량 부재로 인해 추세 지속 여부는 불확실하며 위장 반등 가능성을 배제할 수 없다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: While ADX at 30.4 indicates a clear trend, the lack of volume makes trend sustainability uncertain, and the possibility of a fake rally cannot be ruled out.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3영업일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. 금일 RSI는 63.7에서 60.7로 하락했으나 여전히 중립 구간을 유지하고 있으며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선되는 흐름을 보이고 있다. 5일 연속 상승 후 횡보하며 방향성 부재를 나타내 관망을 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading sessions. Today, RSI decreased from 63.7 to 60.7 but remains in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram shows an improving trend. Following 5 consecutive days of gains, the price is consolidating sideways, indicating a lack of direction, thus maintaining the wait-and-see approach.
